pages.text: Beyond the plates the mod itself provides, a banquet table also takes any food that can be placed as a block — cake is the simplest. Other mods are supported too: Farmer's Delight and its many addons, Kaleidoscope Cookery, Youkai's Feasts, and Some Assembly Required.

Food that needs a container counts as well, so there is no need to worry that guests cannot taste it.$(br2)In Youkai's Feasts, food on plates, in bowls, in pots and in bamboo tubes, on the cuisine board or inside a steam rack is all detected just the same.
